title: 4-bit barrel shifter (logical-left + rotate-right modes)
problemDescription: Registered 4-bit selector with two outputs. se selects how many LSBs are dropped: Q zero-fills cleared positions, Q2 sign-extends with I(3). se=00 passes through; se=01 clears Q(0) and shifts I(3:1) into Q2(2:0) with I(3) prepended; se=10 clears Q(1:0) and Q2 sign-extends two bits; se=11 keeps only I(3) in Q's MSB / replicates I(3) across all of Q2.
